key_insight: AdvancedMathBench aims to move AI evaluation beyond “got the final answer” by testing whether models can generate and verify rigorous advanced mathematical proofs. It provides a more fine-grained way to measure reasoning quality across advanced math domains.
problem_solved: Current math benchmarks mostly focus on high-school or olympiad problems and often judge models only by final-answer correctness. This paper addresses the lack of broad coverage and detailed evaluation for advanced mathematical proof generation and verification.
method: Builds a benchmark suite focused on advanced mathematics rather than only competition-style problems.
Evaluates both proof generation and proof verification, not just final answers.
Uses more granular scoring to assess reasoning validity and proof quality across disciplines.
impact: This gives researchers a stronger testbed for measuring whether LLMs can do genuine mathematical reasoning, not just pattern matching. For practitioners, it helps identify model strengths, failure modes, and progress on advanced symbolic reasoning tasks.
visual_elements: A pipeline diagram showing problem → proof generation → verification → granular scoring
A coverage map of advanced math subfields included in the benchmark
A side-by-side comparison of old benchmarks vs AdvancedMathBench evaluation depth
An icon set for theorem proving, verification, and reasoning quality
paper_title: AdvancedMathBench: A Benchmark Suite for Advanced Mathematical Proof Generation and Verification
paper_authors: Lingkai Kong, Zijian Wu, Yuzhe Gu, Haiteng Zhao, Wenyong Huang
